blocks.text: Origin / creation. Specialists maintained the Anchor: shared facts, witness signatures, unresolved work, and checks against silent alteration used to test whether the First Place persisted.
Identity / human status. Artificial institutional role. No single founder is canonically identified.
Importance. They made collective memory auditable and ensured that neither an archive nor returning participants were automatically treated as infallible.
Decline or transformation. Central access became a political and security risk. The Commons distributed verification and made the centralized office obsolete.
Final status / surviving function. Institutionally obsolete. Their methods survive in provenance chains, continuity courts, archive comparison, and suspicion of any single authoritative memory.
